query:
SELECT 
  a.id, 
  a.devedorId, 
  a.status, 
  a.installments,
  a.agreedAmount,
  COUNT(p.id) as total_parcelas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'pendente' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as parcelas_pendentes
FROM acordos a
LEFT JOIN parcelas p ON a.id = p.acordoId
WHERE a.devedorId = 120001
GROUP BY a.id;
